name: Claude Code — Basic
description: Single-panel Claude Code session. Simplest possible setup: one terminal, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in env, then `claude` to start. Use this when you're learning Claude Code or doing a focused single-task session.

tabs.label: Claude Code
startCommands: echo 'Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY first if not already set, then run: claude'
tabs.system_prompt_hint: Single Claude Code session. Default to clear, runnable answers. Cite file paths when referencing code.

env_hints.purpose: Required for Claude Code. Get one at console.anthropic.com → API Keys.

notes: Cheapest pack to get value out of — one terminal, one job.
After `claude` starts, you can change directory inside the session with /cd or by exiting and re-launching from a new cwd.
